feedback: The confession follows the available route and the material contradiction I used to accuse Al. Opening the bottle at the preview and putting poison in the glass later specifies his actions, but adds no new decisive clue needed to identify him. His explanation for the false scrap source confirms the inference fairly. The call home becomes more affecting when he admits the dependent person never asked him to kill; it prevents the caring responsibility from serving as an excuse. Chip and Elle's confessions distinguish their lesser frauds without erasing their culpability. The ending feels earned, though its explicit evidence recap remains slightly instructional.
